Testing Frameworks: Develop unit, integration, and regression tests for ML models. 
Reproducibility Assurance: Confirm experiments and results can be consistently replicated. 
Compliance Auditing: Verify adherence to industry standards (ISO, IEEE, FDA, DO-178C for aerospace).

2. Validation (Building the Right System) 
Requirement Alignment: Confirm the AI system meets user and business requirements. 
Performance Evaluation: Test accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and robustness against adversarial inputs. 
Bias and Fairness Assessment: Identify and mitigate discriminatory outcomes in models. 
Safety and Reliability Testing: Validate system behavior in real-world or simulated environments. 
User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Engage stakeholders to ensure the system fulfills its intended purpose.

🚗🔬We're hiring a postdoc or research engineer in Scientific Machine Learning for dynamical systems.

After working on lateral vehicle dynamics with Fabien Lionti, we're opening a new front: longitudinal dynamics, as part of a partnership between INRIA ACENTAURI Inria and DGA - Direction générale de l'armement focused on modernizing the numerical methods used for military vehicle testing.

🎯Ground vehicle testing today generates massive volumes of data (inertial units, onboard sensors, dedicated measurement chains). This data is rich but noisy, incomplete, and hard to fully exploit with classical physical models or purely statistical learning approaches alone.
This project sits at the intersection of two scientific directions: Physics-Informed AI, applied to the analysis and simulation of longitudinal vehicle dynamics.

🔍Possible research directions:
- Exploitation and qualification of test data (signal synchronization, drift/outlier detection, identification of dynamic regimes)
- Hybrid physics-learning modeling (stability, physical constraint compliance, interpretability), with priority given to longitudinal dynamics
- Virtual sensors and uncertainty quantification (Bayesian methods, model ensembles, GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo)

🛠️Resources:
- Computing resources dedicated to machine learning and numerical simulation
- Professional licenses (OpenAI Codex, Claude Code) to speed up prototyping and documentation
- Supervision by researchers from INRIA ACENTAURI (Sophia-Antipolis) Philippe Martinet and LERIA (Université d'Angers) Nicolas GUTOWSKI, PhD in AI, control, and robotics, alongside the DGA Techniques Terrestres teams

👤Profile:
- PhD in AI, control/automation, robotics, computational mechanics, applied mathematics, signal processing, or scientific simulation
- Strong skills in at least two of the following: ML/AI, dynamical modeling, scientific computing (Python/PyTorch/NumPy), multibody mechanics
- Experience with Physics-Informed AI, system identification, state estimation, or uncertainty quantification is a strong plus
Automotive dynamics experience is a bonus, not a requirement

📩Application: CV, cover letter, list of publications, two references, and if possible a link to code or previous work.
